basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully updated split-level home in the highly desirable Bernal Heights neighborhood of San Francisco. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, this spacious residence offers a versatile layout with living and family rooms on both levels—perfect for modern, flexible living. Enjoy numerous upgrades throughout, including fresh designer paint inside and out, engineered wood flooring, new recessed lighting, a state-of-the-art fireplace, stylishly remodeled bathrooms, and a spectacular contemporary kitchen with premium finishes and top of the line Thermador Appliances. The lower level also includes its own private entrance, ideal for guests or multi-generational living.  Step outside to a welcoming front yard and an absolutely stunning backyard and deck—beautifully designed for low maintenance and perfect for outdoor dining, relaxation, or entertaining. Just minutes from local parks, shopping, and popular dining spots, and a quick drive to Downtown, Chase Center, and Oracle Park, this location delivers the best of San Francisco living. Experience the quiet charm and community feel of Bernal Heights while staying close to the vibrant city energy you love. This home truly offers the ideal blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience.
